verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an official SDK via npm with full TypeScript definitions, CLI scaffolding, and CDN distribution, and additionally provides a first-party MCP server (phaser.io/agent/mcp) explicitly built for AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with 40+ specialised tools for building games via natural language. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works reliably in practice, and machine-readable docs support (llms.txt and docs .md probes both return 404), which would strengthen the AI-native building experience.
